name: @epoch/renderer-adapters
description: Epoch Renderer Adapters kernel (W019, experience layer) — the renderer-side half of Renderer/Device Adaptation: the provider-neutral ADAPTER SEAM the W013 renderer-runtime pin reserved for this Work Order ("concrete engines are future adapters behind the descriptor contract"). Ships a neutral renderer-TECHNIQUE vocabulary and catalog (immediate-2d, retained-scene-3d, stereoscopic-compositor, remote-stream, reduced-2d — techniques, never vendors/engines/APIs), typed renderer-adapter descriptors declaring which W013 RendererDescriptor family an adapter serves, deterministic adapter selection over a sealed W013 RendererBinding plus a W019 DeviceCapabilityAssessment (chosen technique + ordered fallback chain + typed per-candidate rejections — the decision trace is data), typed mount plans for W013 mount-graph invocations, and an append-only adaptation-event vocabulary over the mirrored W010 event shapes (`renderer-adapter:*` namespace; event-log stays a devDep — type parity, never a runtime edge). Zero engine imports, zero GPU code, zero UI-framework dependencies, zero wall-clock, zero randomness.
